MappingPage - canvas composition before tldraw
|-- The page composes application services and workspace UI.
|   |-- MappingPocPage supplies MappingServices through React context.
|   |-- MappingWorkspacePage uses the diagram and canvas history services.
|   |   `-- Their injected lifetimes are unspecified by this page.
|   |-- The page creates CanvasWorkspace and DiagramEditCoordinator.
|   |   `-- Cleanup disposes both and flushes locally created storage before disposal.
|   `-- Storage may be injected or created as WorkspaceStorage.
|-- CanvasWorkspace manages the open draft sessions.
|   |-- Draft metadata records names, saved baselines, visibility and busy state.
|   |-- setDrafts creates CanvasSession instances from document seeds.
|   |   `-- Replacement removes subscriptions and disposes the previous session.
|   |-- A controller registry gives commands access to each session controller.
|   |-- Commit subscriptions request persistence and update workspace changes.
|   `-- Status subscriptions derive the set of dirty scenes.
|-- CanvasSession publishes separate views of controller state.
|   |-- Construction creates a MappingDocumentController.
|   |-- Public stores allow reads and subscriptions; writable stores stay private.
|   |   |-- Document consumers receive the document reference.
|   |   |-- Presentation consumers receive display state and diagram views.
|   |   `-- Other stores expose selection, controls, geometry and status.
|   |-- Controller notifications synchronously refresh changed stores.
|   |-- Saved scene, edge and name baselines determine dirty status.
|   `-- Disposal unsubscribes and clears commit listeners.
|-- The controller keeps document state separate from canvas state.
|   |-- MappingGridDocument carries the scene, edges, sections and optional jumps.
|   |   `-- The scene supplies the box hierarchy and referenced diagram contents.
|   |-- MappingCanvasState carries selection, diagram views, display and controls.
|   |   |-- SelectionState records ordered membership and captured regions.
|   |   |-- DisplayState holds floating panes and their child relationships.
|   |   `-- Controls retain focus, active thread and per-selection surfaces.
|   `-- canvasDisplayNodes derives a read-only registry from both states.
|       |-- Grid entries expose cell bounds, content and collapse information.
|       `-- Floating entries expose pixel geometry; arrows derive from edges.
|-- The page manages navigation and live viewing resources.
|   |-- Active and previously mounted document IDs determine visible canvas views.
|   |-- DraggableDiagramCanvas receives camera state and reports camera changes.
|   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas receives the session and command callbacks.
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState manages live scroll entries, cameras and timers.
|   |   |-- Bindings guard writes with a viewer-specific owner token.
|   |   |-- Capture samples matching source panes into saved display state.
|   |   `-- Pruning removes stale pane entries; cleanup flushes and disposes timers.
|   `-- The explorer receives names, scenes, dirty IDs and open or delete callbacks.
|-- Search and edit surfaces use current document information.
|   |-- DiagramSearchService is created with a worker factory and later disposed.
|   |   |-- Search combines settled saved revisions, visible drafts and a proposal.
|   |   `-- Revealing a result checks its content revision and ASCII hash.
|   |-- DiagramEditCoordinator opens an edit for a selected grid diagram.
|   |   `-- DiagramEditComposer receives that coordinator.
|   `-- ChangeSessionPreview supplies proposal search data and acceptance callbacks.
|-- The page coordinates persistence and document lifecycle.
|   |-- Startup loads project representations and the stored workspace.
|   |-- Opening a saved representation derives its document and optional history.
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence is created after project and storage readiness.
|   |   `-- Cleanup releases its subscriptions; busy operations pause synchronization.
|   |-- Project saves capture scene, edges, history and name before awaiting a reply.
|   |   `-- The acknowledged capture becomes the saved baseline.
|   |-- Workspace capture samples each controller history, display and camera.
|   |-- Restore checks project identity and replaces draft sessions and view state.
|   `-- Deletion retires linked transfers and flushes remaining workspace records.
`-- Agent commands and transfers share the workspace.
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge receives document descriptors and the command handler.
    |-- Agent reads and mutations resolve the relevant document controller.
    |-- A pending transfer retains source ID, selected instances and checkpoint ID.
    |   `-- Transfer preparation requires that source checkpoint to remain current.
    `-- Transfer publication saves the proposed workspace before installing it.
